changeSet.author: Kirill Shilets
changeSet.comment:
Bills keep a projection of the account owner so that authorization no longer needs a synchronous call to account-service, and so that call can happen outside the balance transaction.
The column stays nullable: rows created before this changeset have no owner to backfill from without calling account-service per row. The service falls back to the remote lookup while the projection is missing and always writes it for new bills.
